findings.text: logs/negative-control-guard-removed.log:1 names revision c1cbdb3d52c14484d0482e81ba92d80fb5c42d99 as the tree the control ran at, but the mutation it exercises is introduced by 49440be29c, which post-dates the log; the log was written against an uncommitted worktree whose committed revision did not contain the patch it proves works, so a reader cannot identify the tree the red log measured. Re-running the control at 65e4ad4 reproduces the red result (1 failed, EXIT=1, exit_code 0 at tests/test_a_plain_complete_refuses_an_unmerged_head.py:194), so the defect is in the record's provenance, not in the repair.

logs/census-arm.log:1 likewise names revision c1cbdb3d52c14484d0482e81ba92d80fb5c42d99 while the D25 census change it reports as 37 passed landed in 49440be29c; the census passes here at 65e4ad4 (37 passed), so again the tree identifier is stale rather than the result wrong.

manifest.md:11 records the gate command without the -n 4 the log it cites actually ran, while manifest.md:18's after_suite names the same after-arm.log; the recorded command and the log header disagree, so promotion's gate receipt cannot be re-run to reproduce the cited result.

justifications.scope_discipline: the delta touches only tests/test_a_plain_complete_refuses_an_unmerged_head.py, tests/test_crew_refusal_visibility.py and the evidence fragment; tests/test_crew_refusal_visibility.py was granted in the repair advice and the other two are in the node's declared write paths.
